card.name: Inside place names in web text
card.fires_on: Partway through proper place names, such as towns, regions and islands, often just after "of" or "in", where the name is split into pieces (Orvieto, Burgundy, Poitiers, Silver Spring).

modes.label: Split place names
modes.description: The first or middle piece of a geographic name that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: King of<< Burg>>undy, that they had been condemned unjust

modes.label: Linking words in place phrases
modes.description: Small words like "of", "in" or "the" inside a named territory or city phrase.
modes.example: Heard Island and<< the>> McDonald Islands, and Macquarie Island

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of place names, especially older European towns and regions, before the name is finished.
